plan.summary: Fix race condition in TodoApp.add() that can produce duplicate IDs with concurrent processes
plan.approach: File locking with fcntl - use exclusive lock during add operation to ensure atomicity
plan.test_strategy: Add multiprocessing test that spawns concurrent add() operations and verifies all IDs are unique
plan.implementation_details: Use fcntl.flock to acquire an exclusive lock on a .lock file before the load-compute-save sequence in add(), ensuring only one process can add at a time
